//: Marks SCP-173 as currently under the player's observation.  Applied by the freeze attack every turn it is watched; expires on its own the moment observation stops.  This is what makes 'cannot be harmed while observed' work without re-deriving sight state at damage time (which is fragile at range <= 1 - see the note in scp_173_attacks.json).
name: Observed
desc: Being watched holds it perfectly still.
